description: This file implements a logging integration for Datadog's LLM Observability Service within a larger machine learning/LLM project. It defines a class 'DataDogLLMObsLogger' that handles constructing and sending telemetry payloads related to LLM call events, errors, and metrics, often referencing other parts of the project such as utility functions, types, and configurations. It manages batching, asynchronous sending, and extraction of detailed metadata including tool calls, latency, and spend metrics.

classes.name: DataDogLLMObsLogger
classes.description: A logger class for integrating Datadog's LLM Observability, capable of batching, asynchronously sending traces, extracting detailed metadata from LLM call data, and handling errors. It extends 'DataDogLogger' and 'CustomBatchLogger'.
